title: CreateAwsCredentialRequest
description: Request object for creating AWS IAM or Access & Secret Key cloud credentials.

clusters.description: List of cluster CRNs where the credential should be created.

type.description: Type of the credential. Additional required parameters by type: IAM: none; ACCESSKEY: accessKey, secretKey. Superfluous parameters are ignored. Providing IAM will create an IAM Role-based Authentication account in Cloudera Manager. Providing ACCESSKEY will create an AWS Access Key Authentication account in Cloudera Manager.
